description: Validates static quality contracts, lint and type policy, and strict config through quality-health.

capabilities.label: Surface Quality Coverage
capabilities.description: Scenario resolution, supported surface classification, and explicit coverage gaps for quality rule packs.

levels.name: No quality target
levels.description: The target scenario cannot be resolved or surfaced for static-quality analysis.
levels.capability_summary: Quality Health cannot inspect a target surface.
levels.next_unlock: A readable scenario with discoverable API, CLI, UI, or package surfaces.

levels.name: Surfaces classified

levels.capability_summary: Quality rule-pack coverage is known for discovered surfaces.

levels.name: Coverage clean
levels.description: Every discovered quality surface is covered by a rule pack or an explicit non-applicability decision.
levels.capability_summary: Static-quality coverage is clean across discovered surfaces.

levels.name: TypeScript checks unavailable

levels.name: TypeScript quality clean

levels.name: Go surface inspectable

levels.next_unlock: go.mod, golangci-lint config, required linters, and justified suppressions.

levels.name: Strict Go baseline

levels.name: Go quality clean

capabilities.label: Fleet Static Quality

levels.name: Fleet-ready static quality

QUALITY_COVERAGE_GAP.reason: Adding a quality contract for an uncovered surface is a design decision that needs human judgment.

TS_DANGEROUS_PATTERNS.reason: Source-semantic suppressions require human intent and are not safe config rewrites.

UI_LAZY_CHUNK_RECOVERY.reason: Installing the reload guard is an app-entry code change, not a safe config rewrite.

GO_DANGEROUS_PATTERNS.reason: Source suppressions require a written reason, not automated source edits.

SCENARIO_PRIVILEGE_BOUNDARY.reason: Runtime elevation must be covered by a setup-provisioned safeguard or a typed privilege-broker action.

SHELL_SYNTAX_LINT.reason: Shell syntax fixes require human intent; quality-health detects, it does not rewrite scripts.

QUALITY_PERSONAL_ABSOLUTE_PATHS.reason: Source must not encode operator-specific absolute paths or identities.

QUALITY_NO_RUNTIME_HOME_LITERALS.reason: Runtime-home resolution must use the shared authority.

QUALITY_ADOPTION_RULES_ALIGNMENT.reason: Repository-aware code must consume shared contract helpers.

QUALITY_HOST_INVENTORY_AUTHORITY.reason: Host facts must come from internal/hostinventory.
